description: Environment setup and baseline. There is nothing to install (Unity project, Editor is open so no batchmode). Establish the out-of-Unity compile check and confirm the baseline is green before any change.
steps: Copy .agents/tasks/task-realistic-physics-colliders/compile_check.ps1 to .agents/tasks/task-fridge-stock-respawn/compile_check.ps1 (keep content, it already points to the project path and Unity 6000.3.25f1 install).

Extend the copy with a third compile step for editor scripts: compile every .cs under Assets/Editor with -define:UNITY_EDITOR, references = the same engine refs + Unity.XR.Interaction.Toolkit.dll, Unity.XR.CoreUtils.dll + the runtime check dll + Editor\Data\Managed\UnityEditor.dll (the UnityEditor.*Module dlls are in Editor\Data\Managed\UnityEngine). Run the script and record the baseline error count of runtime, EditMode, PlayMode and Editor sources in this feature's findings. If the baseline is not 0 errors, report which errors are pre-existing (do not fix unrelated code) and set the baseline comparison accordingly.

Editor step uses Assets/Editor/**/*.cs via glob, so it will pick up SetupFridgeStock.cs automatically.
